caption:
Flying into Sapporo with a big suitcase? ✈️🚆
The easiest way into the city is the train.

🥇 JR Rapid Airport train
🚉 The station is right under the
Domestic Terminal. Follow the signs down.
💳 Tap Suica, ICOCA, PASMO or Kitaca
and board any non-reserved car.
🎫 No IC card? Ticket machines take cash only.
The orange reserved-seat machines take cards.
🧳 Two pieces of luggage per person.

🥈 Airport bus, if your hotel is a stop
🚌 It stops at Sapporo Station, Susukino
and several big Odori hotels.
💴 No booking. Pay when you get off:
cash, contactless card or PayPay.
❌ Suica doesn't work on the bus.
🧳 One suitcase per person in the hold.

💡 Busy day?
Car 4 has reserved u-seats.
You get a seat and room for a big case.
Book ahead online.

🍣 A Hakodate seafood bowl is waiting
inside the terminal.
DM us CHITOSE and we'll send you where.
